code_execution: none (external scripts were read, not executed)
source_review_boundary: Selected primary source methods, not every skill in these repositories and not all internet skills.

sources.method: The generic grader must distinguish runtime error from a negative trigger; this implementation appends false on future exceptions, so an all-error negative case can count as passed. Do not import its executor.
Same-slice comparison, causal pruning, model adaptation, holdout and stopping conditions are largely covered in ADK.
Keep minimal-diff candidate and record failed hypotheses; avoid recreating an optimizer engine.
ADK already distinguishes source-to-sink proof, coverage and policy identity.
Conditional pointers and branch-wise disclosure; no global rewrite without observed failure.
Alternative designs can be useful; never mandate 3+ agents on routine changes.
Type-, lifetime-, concurrency- and reachability-specific verification; existing ADK safety reviews largely cover it.
Survival alone does not establish an equivalent mutant; check typed domains, reachability, consumption and distinguishing inputs. Candidate low-cost addition when mutation evidence is used.
Behavioral fixture demands a measured bottleneck and measured guard, not generic assertions.
Independent reads can overlap; dependency and mutation operations remain ordered. React-specific tuning stays outside embedded core.
Scoped find/raw snapshots reduce browser context; no browser capability added to ADK solely for this method.
Build options can silently change dispatch; verify actual running implementation before attributing hardware/kernel performance.
Verify loaded binary/library/dispatch and use a nonaffected control when drift contaminates A/B; do not copy repository-specific flags or universal same-binary mandates.
Separate diagnosis layers from kernel implementation; ADK already has profile boundaries.
For proven asynchronous readiness failures, use exact-operation conditions/events with bounded monotonic deadlines and cancellation. Preserve timing-contract tests.
